methodology.split: Deterministic 30% development / 70% held-out test split, stratified by NAB data category using SHA-256 file ordering.
methodology.thresholdSelection: One global threshold per detector selected by maximizing the NAB standard-profile score on development files only; applied unchanged to held-out files.
methodology.scoreCaveat: Uses the NAB time-window scoring formulation and corpus-local null/perfect normalization. Scores are not leaderboard results; NAB leaderboard protocols optimize thresholds over their full corpus.
